gate_criteria.description: Cache/projection loss affects speed, not correctness; private state is never shared-cached or used stale for economic authorization
verified_points: Explicit Cache-Control classification: PRIVATE_NO_CACHE (private, no-store) for wallets/saves/sessions, SHORT_TTL_EPHEMERAL (private, max-age=2) for queue/matches, and PUBLIC_PROJECTED (s-maxage/stale-while-revalidate) for public rankings/profiles.
Versioned projections enforce monotonic sequence updates, rejecting stale versions and replaying identically.
ensureReadProjectionIndexes prepares query paths on PG16; materializeLeaderboardProjection materializes rankings correctly from PostgreSQL.
Bounded cache invalidations trigger atomically on match.completed, profile.updated, friend.updated, and save.updated.
Private state shared-cache guard throws PRIVATE_STATE_SHARED_CACHE_FORBIDDEN on any attempt to store private state with shared: true.
Total cache loss / wipe leaves authoritative PostgreSQL data 100% byte-identical and correct; cache loss affects only latency, not correctness.
Cache hit load reduction measured at >90% hit rate (91% read reduction); stale-while-revalidate tolerance window confirmed.
